Why me!

I’m Reshma Raheja, a digital marketer and social media content creator who believes good marketing starts with a clear idea and honest communication.

I’m drawn to the space where creativity meets strategy: graphic design in Canva, reels and video editing, social media content, and helping local businesses become easier to find on Google.

I also design WordPress websites, from business sites and landing pages to personal portfolios, so a brand’s social presence and its website look and speak as one.

Every post, reel and campaign I make has a job to do: help a brand look confident, sound human and grow a digital presence people remember.

I’m currently pursuing my B.Com and I’m a Certified Digital Marketer. I run my work independently under my brand, Reshma Digital.
